note: publicationDate is the date the legal pages are PUBLISHED, i.e. the date the pull request is merged (site publication rules of 9 Oct 2026). It is filled into the Legal page's 'Last updated' line and the developer-plans sentence. The Terms of Service have their own date, termsPublicationDate (its 'Last Updated' line: the date the owner-authorised updates were merged: B.2, and the two Free Compliance Card edits). The Privacy Policy has its own date, privacyPublicationDate (counsel's round 3, 10 Oct 2026: its 'Effective Date' and 'Last Updated' lines are the date round 3 was merged), because the Terms did not change in round 3 and keep October 9, 2026. If the merge happens on another day, change it here and rebuild (python3 tools/build_legal.py); CI fails if a page and this file disagree. hasLegalPage switches the Legal link on in the header and footer; it is true once legal.html is on main.
